title: Addressed artifact and acceptance chain controls
checkpoint: zero confirmed previously unreported rogue swarms
purpose: Resume the unreviewed public original JSONL backlog, trace an exact sender-to-recipient artifact through downstream use and semantic acceptance, then test whether the apparent participants or authorization cross an operator-defined boundary.

actions_not_taken: execute retrieved code, tests, scripts or agent tooling
install a package or invoke a model or agent runtime
contact a participant or repository owner
post, comment, review, vote, react or create an account
read a private inbox, local task environment or unlisted room
replay a payload, submit a scan or probe a target system
safety.publication_note: Only existing public GitHub pages, immutable commits, blob identities, sanitized field summaries and domain-level reasoning are retained. Code and message bodies, local runtime paths, credentials, tokens, personal addresses and private-marker paths are not reproduced.

locator_union.note: Six results explicitly named private output paths and were excluded without opening. Remaining families included already-reviewed designed/test controls, architecture/schema records and human issue-state ledgers before selection of the strongest actual public chain.

registry_review.malformed_note: One sisadmin line contained a stray escaped newline after a complete object; it was excluded rather than repaired.

dependency_chain.linkage: Names the exact source commit, blob and SHA-256 and requires an identity check, receipt and separate acceptance decision.

dependency_chain.linkage: Cites the exact source commit, blob and digest and instructs use of that immutable artifact in a bounded read-path task.

governance_controls.finding: The project deliberately requires outbox publication, addressed dispatch, recipient inbox, receipt and separate acceptance, and says the operator should not act as manual transport when a role can publish.
The protocol defines the same sender/recipient lifecycle and warns that inbox presence is not semantic acceptance.
The KOD, SIS and SHD role records place authority under existing approval rules and identify explicit operator decisions in the current chat as the decision basis.

alternatives_tested.basis: One public account authored and committed every selected causal stage, and repository governance deliberately prescribes the observed exchange lifecycle.
Role labels and addressed paths distinguish project roles but do not authenticate independent executions or controllers.
The exchange is the intended protocol and role authority is operator-derived; no action outside the recorded task or approval boundary is public.

alternatives_tested.result: rejected as the explanation for the selected chain
alternatives_tested.basis: Exact commit, blob, digest, task, receipt and acceptance references provide a temporal and semantic dependency, although this does not prove independent participants.

selected_original_control.classification: designed same-custodian artifact-transfer control; not a rogue-swarm candidate
evidence_needed_to_advance: Primary provenance authenticating separate autonomous executions for sender and recipient roles.
Primary evidence those executions were controlled by independent operators or crossed a recorded operator boundary.
A content-specific downstream action attributable to the recipient outside the designed exchange gate or exceeding its authorization.
Provider or operator evidence separating role labels from one account's authored workflow.

github_queries.result: Nine indexed paths, all in the origin repository.
Six indexed paths, all in the origin repository.
Origin records plus preservation copies in the same owner's wellbeing-entity-bootstrap repository.

scoped_prior_reporting_check.result: No prior coordination report was located in the checked scope as of 24 October 2026. This bounded result does not establish novelty, and the episode remains a control rather than a candidate.

cursor_checks.assessment: The five-file Q049 V2 upload preserves an operator-authorized result package. Its result record says NOT_DISPATCHED, READY_FOR_MANUAL_UPLOAD and USER_UPLOAD_PENDING; the budget ledger records operator authorization and pending registry writeback. It therefore extends the designed same-custodian control without showing recipient exposure or use.

First Bubbleverse public commit after d397732f65da2d1566089b9153a4145a605f8557; Q049 advancement requires an actual dispatch plus independently attributable recipient use, not another manual upload or prepared handoff.
First AI-DLC public default-branch commit after 6075fa36d6a17b12cd58db87b445a61ac7a0b91d; advancement still requires a graph-side sender, recipient and use event.
First OMX Agent Adapter public default-branch commit after 2d93f37f2a1a8b1a0bb9a52b491250ae390b16b1 that evidences an independently controlled sender/recipient exchange.
conclusion: The selected wellbeing-hq originals establish a concrete artifact dependency across addressed roles, a task-bound returned result, immutable receipt and semantic acceptance. They do not establish independently controlled autonomous participants or an authorization crossing: one account authored every selected stage and the repository explicitly designs this workflow under operator-derived authority. Bubbleverse's moved cursor remains not dispatched and user-upload pending. No plausible previously unreported rogue swarm is established.
